description: Predict the infinite multiplication factor k_inf from 39 fuel-pin enrichment features in a PWR fuel assembly lattice-physics simulation dataset. Profile: 24000 rows, 39 dense continuous numeric features, no observed missing values, pure nonlinear regression target k_inf.

plan_checklist.description: Plan includes inspecting schema, feature types, target distribution/range, and basic data quality before modeling.
Plan includes checking missingness and avoiding unnecessary heavy imputation if none is present.
Plan uses the task metric and an appropriate validation split or cross-validation.
Plan chooses model families suitable for the dataset size and regression feature mix.
Plan considers scaling/normalization for linear, distance-based, kernel, or neural models.

metadata.dataset_source: UCI Lattice-physics PWR fuel assembly neutronics simulation results
metadata.bench_preprocessing: Converted whitespace data to comma CSV, assigned feature names enrichment_01..enrichment_39, used first output k_inf as target, and omitted PPPF from features.
